cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema matches the supplied schema
cases.description: All arguments are non‑null and represent a valid JSON schema. The method should delegate to newJsonSchema and return a properly constructed JsonSchema object.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance (default configuration applied)
cases.description: Configuration is null – the factory should fall back to its default SchemaValidatorsConfig and still produce a JsonSchema.

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that schemaUri must not be null
cases.description: When the schema location is null the factory cannot resolve a schema; the method should reject the call with a clear exception.

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that jsonNode must not be null
cases.description: A null JsonNode means there is no schema definition to parse; the method should fail fast with an appropriate exception.

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) for the first null argument encountered
cases.description: All three arguments are null – the method must guard against nulls and throw a predictable exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException or IOException indicating that the URI is malformed or cannot be accessed
cases.description: A malformed URI should be detected early and result in an exception rather than an undefined JsonSchema.

cases.expected: IOException (or a custom SchemaLoadingException) because the classpath resource cannot be found
cases.description: When the supplied classpath location does not exist the factory should surface the loading failure.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException indicating that the root node must be an OBJECT node
cases.description: A JSON schema must be represented by an object node; providing an array should cause validation to reject the input.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (schema parsing succeeds) but later validation of data will fail for unknown keywords
cases.description: The method should still create a JsonSchema even if the node contains unknown keywords; schema creation does not enforce strict keyword validation.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose ValidationContext reflects the custom config (typeLoose = true)
cases.description: Passing a config with typeLoose enabled should be honored by the created schema; the test verifies that the returned schema is not null and that the custom flag is stored in its context.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance that will accept any string for the 'email' format because the custom format validator always returns true
cases.description: Ensures that a user‑provided format validator factory is correctly injected and influences the resulting schema's validation behavior.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema is the Draft‑06 meta‑schema
cases.description: The $schema keyword should drive meta‑schema selection; the factory must load the Draft‑06 meta‑schema even though the default version flag may be later.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema matches the custom URI supplied in the config
cases.description: Verifies that a custom meta‑schema URI configured via SchemaValidatorsConfig is respected when the $schema keyword points to it.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException indicating that the URI scheme 'ftp' is not supported
cases.description: The factory should reject schema locations with unsupported schemes and throw a clear IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: IOException (or UncheckedIOException) indicating that the remote schema could not be retrieved
cases.description: When the supplied HTTP URI points to a host that cannot be resolved, the factory should surface the I/O failure rather than returning a schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that the $ref target could not be resolved
cases.description: A $ref that points to a non‑existent definition must cause schema creation to fail with a descriptive exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException indicating a cyclic $ref reference
cases.description: A schema that references itself directly (or indirectly) should be detected as cyclic and result in a JsonSchemaException.

group: Malformed custom meta‑schema URI in config

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException indicating that the custom meta‑schema URI is malformed
cases.description: When a user supplies an invalid URI via setCustomMetaSchemaUri, the factory must reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.

group: Null custom meta‑schema URI in config

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that custom meta‑schema URI must not be null
cases.description: The configuration should validate that a custom meta‑schema URI, if set, is non‑null.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException indicating that maxDepth must be positive
cases.description: SchemaValidatorsConfig should reject nonsensical values such as a negative maxDepth, throwing an IllegalArgumentException during schema creation.
